facts.text: Hantek1008Raw communicates with a Hantek1008 device over USB and supports configuring the device and measuring samples with it
Hantek1008 extends Hantek1008Raw with raw-to-volt conversion and zero-offset shift compensation
Channel ids and indices are zero based, and channel names are one based
The vertical scale factors are 0.02, 0.125 and 1.0
get_vscales returns one vertical scale factor per channel and get_active_channels returns the active channel ids
get_zero_offset returns the zero offset of one channel at a vertical scale
init measures the zero offsets of all eight channels at each of the three vertical scales
set_generator_waveform currently accepts at most 62 bytes; each byte is a bit pattern for the eight digital outputs
set_generator_speed asserts a speed of 1 to 750000 rpm and sends a computed pulse length
set_generator_on turns the generator on with parameter 0x01 and off with 0x00
init sets the generator speed to 300000 and turns the generator off
pause starts a thread that sends a ping every 10 ms, cancel_pause stops it, and is_paused reports whether it runs
connect finds the USB device by vendor id 0x0783 and product id 0x5725
close cancels a running pause, sends a ping and command 0xf4, then resets the USB device
The README describes the project as tooling for Hantek 1008 USB oscilloscopes
The README states Python >= 3.6 and requires pyusb and overrides
